chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 111: The Madman – Li Huowang Tests Reality and Chooses Vengeance
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang learns he has two months before Danyangzi consumes him. In a heartbreaking hallucination, he gives his mother gold—then realizes it was all fake. His quiet, lethal decision: kill Danyangzi.
og_title: The Madman (Ch. 111) – He Gave His Mother Gold… and It Wasn’t Real
og_description: A quiet, devastating chapter: Li Huowang slips into a hospital vision, comforts his exhausted mother, gives her gold and jade—then forces himself to remember it’s all a lie. The clock is ticking. Danyangzi must die.
twitter_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 111: Two months left, a stolen red button, and a promise of murder.
twitter_description: Li Huowang uses a red button as a reality test—and fails. The hospital was a hallucination. His mother is a ghost. His answer: kill Danyangzi.
